verdict.rationale: GitBook ships an official MCP server (documented at gitbook.com/docs/docs-as-code/gitbook-mcp) with two live endpoints: an auto-generated per-site MCP server for published docs, and an org-level write-capable MCP server with proper OAuth gating. Runtime probes independently confirmed a full JSON-RPC handshake on the docs MCP endpoint and correct 401/OAuth challenge on the write endpoint, corroborating the vendor docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-GitBook) hands-on reports of agents actually connecting and using the MCP server in production.
